cause_quote: The new `: redirect({ pathname: pathForRoute("model-providers", context.basePath), search: "?connect=1", hash: "" })` branch sent legacy bookmarks to Models only after the model-setup route had been matched.
user_saw: Opening a saved model-setup link from New Session briefly rebuilt the page and delayed the Models account picker.
summary: The fix resolves legacy model-setup URLs to Models before route matching so New Session stays mounted while Models loads, while preserving explicit first-run setup.
reasoning: The introducing diff replaced a direct Model Setup page load with the first legacy bookmark redirect to Models, and I checked that the application router at that revision passed those URLs through to the loader. The outlet at that revision could clear a redirected match, and the fix's test documents the extra mount on its parent, but I could not confirm that the original router dependency and Lit outlet exposed the same intermediate state to the user.
